panels.title: OpenClaw metric series present

panels.description: sum/count average. Histogram quantile is not usable because bucket ceiling is 10s but actual run is ~3min.
panels.title: Message avg latency [1h]

panels.description: Requires provider cost table. newapi currently has none, so always 0.
panels.title: Cost / hour (USD) [5m]

panels.description: Average in ms. Histogram quantile unusable because bucket ceiling is 10s but runs take minutes.
panels.title: Message avg latency by channel [5m avg]

targets.expr: (sum by (openclaw_channel) (rate(openclaw_message_processed_total{openclaw_outcome="error", openclaw_channel=~"$channel"}[15m])) or sum by (openclaw_channel) (rate(openclaw_message_processed_total{openclaw_channel=~"$channel"}[15m]) * 0)) / clamp_min(sum by (openclaw_channel) (rate(openclaw_message_processed_total{openclaw_channel=~"$channel"}[15m])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Message error ratio by channel [15m rate]
Messages queued rate by source [5m rate]

panels.description: Average depth (sum/count). Bucket ceiling is the same 10000 histogram, but depth is usually small so buckets are OK; avg is still more honest under sparse traffic.

targets.expr: sum by (openclaw_lane) (rate(openclaw_queue_depth_sum{openclaw_lane=~"$lane", openclaw_lane!=""}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (openclaw_lane) (rate(openclaw_queue_depth_count{openclaw_lane=~"$lane", openclaw_lane!=""}[5m])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Lane queue depth avg [5m]

panels.description: Average wait (sum/count). Quantile unusable under sparse traffic — lanes without samples return NaN which makes Y axis jump to bucket ceiling.

targets.expr: sum by (openclaw_lane) (rate(openclaw_queue_wait_ms_milliseconds_sum{openclaw_lane=~"$lane", openclaw_lane!=""}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (openclaw_lane) (rate(openclaw_queue_wait_ms_milliseconds_count{openclaw_lane=~"$lane", openclaw_lane!=""}[5m])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Lane wait avg [5m]

panels.description: Average per-session queued items, sampled every heartbeat tick.
panels.title: Heartbeat queue depth avg [5m]

panels.description: Average age of stuck sessions (sum/count). Histogram quantile clamps to 10s because bucket ceiling is 10000ms.
panels.title: Stuck session avg age [10m avg]

panels.description: sum/count average. Histogram quantile clamps to 10s because bucket ceiling is 10000ms but runs take minutes.
panels.title: Agent run avg duration [5m avg]

targets.expr: sum by (openclaw_model) (rate(openclaw_tokens_total{openclaw_token="cache_read", openclaw_provider=~"$provider", openclaw_model=~"$model"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (openclaw_model) (rate(openclaw_tokens_total{openclaw_token=~"input|cache_read", openclaw_provider=~"$provider", openclaw_model=~"$model"}[5m])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Cache hit ratio cache_read / (input + cache_read) [5m rate]

panels.description: This histogram uses unit=1, so buckets are 0..10000 tokens — fine for context-window usage.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, openclaw_model) (rate(openclaw_context_tokens_bucket{openclaw_context="used", openclaw_provider=~"$provider", openclaw_model=~"$model"}[10m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, openclaw_model) (rate(openclaw_context_tokens_bucket{openclaw_context="limit", openclaw_provider=~"$provider", openclaw_model=~"$model"}[10m])))

panels.title: Context tokens p95 used vs limit [10m rate]

panels.description: Session agent lanes only. Each session:agent:<agent>:<channel>:<kind>:<user> lane → agent name. System dispatch lanes (main/nested) excluded.
panels.title: Messages per agent [6h increase]

panels.description: Derived from lane name. direct/group/cron. Unlabeled = non-session lanes.
panels.title: Conversation kind distribution [6h]

panels.description: sum/count per model. Requires diagnostics-otel with widened bucket boundaries to be accurate on long runs.

targets.expr: sum by (openclaw_provider, openclaw_model) (rate(openclaw_run_duration_ms_milliseconds_sum[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (openclaw_provider, openclaw_model) (rate(openclaw_run_duration_ms_milliseconds_count[5m])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Run duration avg by model [5m avg]

panels.description: Internal dispatch/system lanes: main (global dispatch for all incoming messages), nested (nested agent calls), cron (scheduled jobs), subagent (subagent invocations). These are NOT user agents — they have no channel/user labels.
panels.title: System dispatch lanes [6h increase]
